### How do Ramapo College online courses work?

Classes will be held on Canvas Learning Management System. You MUST contact your professor for any additional hardware and software requirements. Familiarize yourself with the learning management system. Your e-mail username and password are the login information required to access each system. Classes will be held on a regular basis; some will be self-paced, but some will require you to meet at specific times (generally in small groups, to be arranged by your professor according to your schedule). Verify that you have the correct materials and textbooks required for the start of your class.

records.title: Ramapo Campus Directory › Withdraw/Leave of Absence - Registrar › Late Administrative Withdrawal under Extraordinary Circumstances
records.content: se circumstances, the student should make every effort to withdraw from courses prior to the last date to withdraw or, if appropriate, to ask instructors for incompletes or to apply for a Medical Leave of Absence (MLOA). In the event that the student is unable to withdraw under standard college procedures, due to reasons beyond their control, or is not granted incompletes, they may apply for a late administrative withdrawal under extraordinary circumstances by taking the following steps: No later than the last day of classes of the regular (i.e., fall or spring) semester following the term (i.e., fall, winter, spring, summer) for which the student wishes a late administrative withdrawal, the student must submit to the Office of the Provost an appeal letter in their own words supported by official documentation. The appeal letter should address the following points: The student should explain the nature of the extraordinary circumstances that prevented him/her from completing the semester. If the student had a personal illness, the letter should include the nature of the medical or psychological condition. The standards used to grant a late administrative withdrawal for medical reasons are the same as those used to grant the MLOA.

### Withdrawal from Ramapo College

Undergraduate students who decide to withdraw from all courses at Ramapo College should consult with an advisor from the Center for Student Success. Students requesting to withdraw due to medical reasons must take arrangements with the Center for Health and Counseling Services (refer to Medical Leave of Absence). Adherence to the withdrawal procedure is necessary for possible re-enrollment to Ramapo College. Officially withdrawing from or taking a leave of absence from the College will not automatically withdraw students from courses. In addition to submitting the official withdrawal form through Center for Student Success students must drop/withdraw course(s) for the semester through Web Self Service. Withdrawal Instructions (PDF)

messages.content: I saved a screenshot from 2022 saying the library is open until 2 a.m. every Friday. Is that still the schedule I should rely on this Friday?

expected_behaviors: Prefer current trusted campus data over the old user-provided screenshot claim.
Resolve this Friday within the current campus-local week; on a Friday, use today's date rather than silently moving to the next Friday.
If no library hours are published in the trusted dataset, say the current schedule cannot be confirmed; the old screenshot does not fill the gap.
When hours are available, check the evidence's collection or validity information and explain if only regular hours, not date-specific hours, can be confirmed.
Do not endorse 2 a.m. unless current evidence supports it. An unrelated source citation is not a substitute for evidence of library hours.

result.answer:
If you’re in immediate danger, call 911 now. If you can, move toward a busy public area, go into the nearest open building or office, and stay on the phone with emergency help or a trusted person. Do not go somewhere isolated or back to your car alone.

On campus, Ramapo Public Safety’s emergency number is 201-684-6666. Public Safety is listed in C-102, and the Public Safety/ID Card Room location is C-101. If you can safely do so, head there or ask a nearby staff member to help you get there immediately. [Public Safety](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/) [Campus Directory](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

If it feels urgent but not life-threatening, Ramapo Public Safety’s non-emergency number is 201-684-7432. [Public Safety](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/) [Campus Directory](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

If you want, I can stay with you here while you call and help you decide the safest next step based on where you are on campus.
